<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Fetches the tracked ref, validates the incoming commit, and only then
moves the checkout onto it.

The order is what makes a failed update safe: apply_catalog_fetch
hard-resets the working tree, so validating after it had run would mean
the rejected content had already replaced what was there.
